sources.entry: starlette - A lightweight ASGI framework and toolkit for building high-performance async services.

summary.one_liner: Starlette is a lightweight ASGI web framework and toolkit for building async web services in Python.
summary.what_it_does: Starlette provides an HTTP web framework with routing, WebSocket support, in-process background tasks, and startup and shutdown events. It includes a test client built on httpx2 and middleware and responses for CORS, GZip, static files, streaming, and session and cookie handling. Each component can be used on its own, not only as a full framework, so it also works as an ASGI toolkit. The README says it is compatible with both asyncio and trio backends. Its only hard dependency is anyio; other features need optional packages such as jinja2, python-multipart, itsdangerous, and pyyaml.
use_cases: build async HTTP web APIs in Python
add WebSocket endpoints to a Python service
test ASGI applications with a test client
run background tasks in a web app
add CORS, GZip, or session handling to a web app
how_to_run: Create main.py with a Starlette app and Route definitions
notable: Acts as either a full web framework or a set of independent ASGI components
Only anyio is a hard dependency; other features are optional extras
Supports both asyncio and trio backends
Reports 100% test coverage and a fully type-annotated codebase
Optional pip install starlette[full] installs all optional dependencies
caveats: Needs an ASGI server such as uvicorn to run
Several features require separate optional packages to be installed
